note: Superior NF rustic campground on Whitefish Lake, the start of the Timber-Frear canoe route, about 17 mi of forest roads inland from Highway 61 near Schroeder (FR 343, 166, 346, 170, then 4.5 mi on FR 348). The Forest Service warns the access road can be difficult to navigate in an oversized vehicle. Carry-down canoe access only and no garbage service. Pad lengths are not posted beyond the forest's 'longer than 21 feet'. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 3 pull-in sites (two longer than 21 ft 'may accommodate an RV'), vault toilet, no drinking water, no fee, May 8-Oct 1, no rec.gov listing (first come). Groups moved to manual; fit and access-road caveats flagged; note rewritten (it is ~23 km from Schroeder, not near Finland). Not waterfront kept; pin confirmed.
flags: CRITERIA (rig length, caveat in the note): the FS singles the rustic campgrounds out - 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Two of three sites are longer than 21 feet and may accommodate an RV.' No stated length of 23 ft+. Unclear fit: keep with the caveat (AWH 2026-11-02), as White Pine Lake 5505 was handled. No review by a 23 ft+ rig was searched up.

CRITERIA (access road, caveat in the note): the FS page singles this one out ('The access road to the campground can be difficult to navigate in an oversized vehicle'); the Wilson Lake page off the same FR 170 does not carry it. No 4WD/high-clearance wording, no grade or driveway warning. Under the 2026-11-10 steep-access rule this reads as a warn, not a drop; the reviewer decides.

STATUS: the FS page shows 'Site Partially Closed / Closed–No fees or services' now, consistent with the season ending Oct 1. The Oct 1 2026 post-wildfire closure order covers the Gunflint, Kawishiwi and LaCroix districts only; this is Tofte. No status written.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: on the 2009 leaf-off frame the campground is a small loop with an open turnaround (about 47.7184,-91.0450) where tents/vehicles show; the Whitefish Lake shore is 30-40 m south behind a solid band of conifers, with only a carry-down path through it. Behind a tree band = a view at best, and no site photo shows one.
PIN 47.71887,-91.04464 equals the FS point, inside the loop (OSM camp_site node 47.71884,-91.04501); confirmed.
